title: Searching a list recursively
description: You can follow contains? as it checks successive list elements.

steps.description: contains? takes a target x and a list l. You return #f immediately when the list is empty.
A matching first element returns #t. Otherwise you search the cdr, the list after its first element, with the same target.

steps.question: Where does the supplied search for 3 stop?
steps.answer: It skips 1 and 2, then finds 3 at the front of the remaining list and returns #t.

steps.description: You see #t in the output. The recursive branch returns its call directly, which places that call in tail position.
